scripts.verify: bun run format:check && knip && bun run build:ci && bun run test
scripts.typecheck: bun check && bun check -p tools && bun check -p build && bun check -p tests
scripts.format: bun fmt src build tools tests docs README.md ARCHITECTURE.md prompt.md index.html tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json knip.json package.json
scripts.lint: bun --bun run oxlint --type-aware src build tools tests --report-unused-disable-directives --deny-warnings
scripts.prebuild: bun run typecheck && bun run lint
